mapper.sql:
FROM post p JOIN board b ON b.company_id = p.company_id AND b.board_id = p.board_id JOIN employee e ON e.company_id = p.company_id AND e.employee_id = p.author_employee_id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.company_id = e.company_id AND d.department_id = e.department_id WHERE p.company_id = #{companyId} AND b.board_type = 'BOARD_NOTICE' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.visible_yn = 'Y'
AND (p.title LIKE '%' || #{w} || '%' OR p.content LIKE '%' || #{w} || '%')
mapper.select:
SELECT p.post_id AS id, 'ALL' AS scope, p.title AS title, e.employee_name AS writerName, d.department_name AS writerDept, TO_CHAR(p.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt, CASE WHEN p.updated_at > p.created_at + INTERVAL '1' SECOND THEN TO_CHAR(p.updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') END AS updatedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_comment c WHERE c.company_id = p.company_id AND c.post_id = p.post_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL) AS commentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_file f WHERE f.company_id = p.company_id AND f.post_id = p.post_id) AS fileCount
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.post_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
